Answer: B
Reason: Scimitar syndrome is characterized by right lung hypoplasia, which leads to volume loss in the right hemithorax. This volume loss causes both the ipsilateral mediastinal shift and the elevation of the right hemidiaphragm seen on the chest X-ray.
